name: Isoroku Yamamoto
contribution: An admiral of the Imperial Japanese Navy and the commander of the Combined Fleet during World War II.
legacy: He was one of the first naval leaders to conclude that naval aviation and aircraft carriers would play a decisive role in any future conflict

checks.lead: Isoroku Yamamoto (山本 五十六, Yamamoto Isoroku; April 4, 1884 – April 18, 1943) was an admiral of the Imperial Japanese Navy (IJN) and the commander of the Combined Fleet during World War II. He commanded the fleet from 1939 until his death in 1943, overseeing the start of the Pacific War in 1941 and Japan's initial successes and defeats before his plane was shot down by U.S. fighter aircraft over New Guinea.
